PRINCIPLE: Test names should describe scenario and expected outcome. RATIONALE: Descriptive names make tests self-documenting. EVALUATION: The method name 'test7' is generic and provides no scenario/result information. DECISION: Name is generic -> non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Avoid verbose auto-generated tests. RATIONALE: Generated tests often have generic names like test7. EVALUATION: The method name 'test7' is indicative of generated tests (EvoSuite style). DECISION: Auto-generated style name -> non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should show thoughtful design (Given-When-Then or BDD). RATIONALE: Designed tests are clearer and more comprehensive. EVALUATION: The method contains no Given-When-Then structure or multiple scenario coverage. DECISION: Minimal single happy path -> non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should target public API behavior, not internals. RATIONALE: Behavior-focused tests are less brittle. EVALUATION: The method calls only public methods (constructor, insere, imprime) and uses no reflection or private access. DECISION: No reflection or internal state checks -> compliant. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Use clear, specific assertions with messages when helpful. RATIONALE: Specific asserts aid diagnostics. EVALUATION: This test contains zero assertions. DECISION: ZERO assertions -> non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Comments should explain 'why', not 'what'. RATIONALE: Minimal useful comments are acceptable. EVALUATION: The method contains no commented-out code and no excessive comments; it's concise. DECISION: No commented-out code and not excessive -> compliant. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests must be deterministic. RATIONALE: Avoid randomness/time-based flakiness. EVALUATION: The method uses no Random, System.currentTimeMillis, Thread.sleep, or external dependencies in the method body. DECISION: No non-deterministic constructs found -> compliant. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should not produce side effects affecting other tests. RATIONALE: Side effects make tests interdependent. EVALUATION: The method only uses local variables and does not persist data, modify static fields, or create files. DECISION: Only local usage -> compliant. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Use tags/categories to organize tests. RATIONALE: Labels enable selective execution. EVALUATION: The method has no @Tag/@Category or similar annotations. DECISION: No categorization present -> non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.
